name: cc-switch-route
tagline: Local smart routing control plane for CC Switch
description: cc-switch-route is a non-intrusive local control plane for CC Switch multi-provider setups: it runs health checks, ranks providers by latency, and reorders routes when recovery happens. Instead of hardcoding a primary provider, traffic follows measured health and latency in real time. For multi-provider power users, it turns a static configuration into something that self-heals.
highlights: Local smart routing control plane for CC Switch
Health checks, latency ranking, and recovery reordering
Non-intrusive — no changes to your existing setup
curatorNote: Multi-provider routing is usually a static config you babysit. A local control plane that measures and reorders automatically is the right answer for anyone juggling several providers.
